modules.title: 点击每一帧，看它对应你代码的哪一行

items.title: 最上面是出错那一刻的位置
items.text: 栈顶附近通常是抛错位置，下面依次是它的调用者；运行环境或第三方库帧也可能排在最前面。

items.title: 只找你自己的文件
items.text: 栈里可能混有运行环境或第三方库的内部帧。属于你自己文件的帧才对应你写过的代码，是修改的起点。

items.title: 类型信息指向变量
items.text: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined 表示代码试图读取 undefined 的属性；结合出错行与实际数据检查哪个值是 undefined。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 调用栈告诉你出错在哪里，不告诉你为什么错。同一段报错可能由数据为空、参数写错或上游改动引起，仍要结合代码和实际数据判断原因。

lessonPractice.title: 运行项目后报错：TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined，栈顶是 node 内部文件，中间有 at loadRows (save.js:24:21)。下一步怎么做？

options.label: 在栈里找到属于自己文件 save.js:24 的那一帧，先看那一行的代码
options.feedback: 栈顶可能是 Node 或第三方库的内部调用；自己文件里的帧才对应你写的代码，是排查的起点。

options.label: 只看最上面一行，因为报错总是从最上面开始
options.feedback: 最上面一帧只是出错时正在执行的函数，可能属于运行环境内部，与你的代码无关。

options.label: 把整段报错原样发给 AI，不做任何判断
options.feedback: 完整报错可以一起发给 AI，但自己先指出自己文件的那一帧，能确认 AI 的修改落在正确位置。

en.title: Running the project reports TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined. The top frame is a Node internal file, and the middle shows at loadRows (save.js:24:21). What should happen next?

options.label: Find the frame in your own file, save.js:24, and read that line first
options.feedback: The top frame can be Node or a third-party library internals. A frame in your own file corresponds to code you wrote and is where investigation starts.

options.label: Read only the topmost line because errors always start there
options.feedback: The topmost frame is just the function running when it failed; it can belong to the runtime and have nothing to do with your code.

options.label: Send the whole error to AI without judging anything
options.feedback: Sending the full trace to AI is fine, but identifying your own file's frame first confirms AI fixes the right location.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 运行 node save.js 报 TypeError，堆栈指向我自己的 loadRows (save.js:24:21)。请从这一帧附近检查代码，并沿调用者追查输入数据，说明最早在哪一步出现 undefined；修复后重新运行并确认结果。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Running node save.js reports a TypeError, and the stack points to my loadRows (save.js:24:21). Start near that frame, then trace its caller and input data to find where undefined first appears; rerun after the fix and verify the result.

learning.assumes: You have seen error text in a terminal or an AI mentioning a failing line.
learning.outcome: You can find a frame from your own file near the top of an error stack and use it as a location clue.

modules.title: Click each frame to see which line of your code it points to
How to read a stack trace

items.title: The frame near the throw is usually near the top
items.text: The frame nearest the throw is usually near the top, followed by its callers; a runtime or third-party frame may appear first.

items.title: Look for your own files only
items.text: The trace can mix in runtime and third-party library internals. Only frames from your own files correspond to code you wrote and can be a starting point for a fix.

items.title: The error type points at a value
items.text: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined means code tried to read a property from undefined; check the failing line and actual data to find which value was undefined.

modules.title: What it does not tell you
modules.text: A stack trace says where it failed, not why. The same error can come from empty data, a wrong argument, or an upstream change, so the cause still needs code and real data to confirm.

distinctions.label: Server logs
distinctions.text: Logs record what happened over time, keeping many entries. A stack trace describes only the call positions at the moment of failure, not the full request history.

distinctions.label: On-page error text
distinctions.text: The message a user sees is a sentence the product writes. A stack trace is raw position output from inside the program, usually visible only in a terminal, logs, or an AI investigation.
